mapper.select: SELECT id, ds_id, biz_operation, service_class, dao_class, sql_template_id, related_tables, knowledge_source, confidence, verified, evidence, status, version, hit_count, error_count, create_time, update_time FROM kb_biz_link WHERE ds_id = #{dsId} AND status <> 'deprecated' AND related_tables LIKE CONCAT('%', '"', #{tableName}, '"', '%') ORDER BY confidence DESC

SELECT id, ds_id, biz_operation, service_class, dao_class, sql_template_id, related_tables, knowledge_source, confidence, verified, evidence, status, version, hit_count, error_count, create_time, update_time FROM kb_biz_link WHERE ds_id = #{dsId} AND verified = 1 AND status = 'active'
AND biz_operation LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operationKeyword}, '%')
AND service_class LIKE CONCAT(#{serviceClass}, '%')
AND related_tables LIKE CONCAT('%', '"', #{tableName}, '"', '%')
ORDER BY confidence DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{topK}
